venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 9/5.** Missed target: net $8,324 vs $8,633 target (−4%); food $437; comps $71.35; 269 guests / $30.94 check avg. MOD Jk/Mkz. Saturday before Labor Day — full house even with the holiday; opener cut around 9pm. Wedding party at 11pm gave a nice push; lots of happy people until 2am. Focus: perfecting garnishes, keeping tabs updated so everyone can serve behind each other, and curiosity about avoiding 86'd items. Kia Lacey did a great job. Kitchen: great job, continue to perfect prep. 86: Myers, trash bags, Angel's Envy; low High Noon. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: Valerie fitting into the team effortlessly. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Saturday 9/5.** Missed target: net $10,700 vs $12,558 target (−15%); food $213; comps $84 (0.7%); 399 guests / $26.82 check avg. MOD KE, chef DJ. Relatively slow Saturday — Tennessee under a heat advisory for a week. Started slow until ~11pm when a wedding party arrived (expected 50, closer to 20–25) and had a phenomenal time. Some regulars and friends, mostly fresh faces. DJ Nassi had a great set. Kitchen: smooth sailing. Maintenance: soda water handle at well one cosmetically broken (lever still works). 86: Lassi. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: road-trip guests from Canada and Florida whom Brandon introduced to his favorite drinks, who came back for a nightcap after dinner. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 9/5.** Beat target: net $23,048.76 incl. events vs $18,104 target (+27%); non-event net $18,086.76 (AM $1,831.33 / PM $16,255.43 / Garden $4,294.18); net event sales $4,962 (event food $3,840); total food incl. events $6,972.86; comps $565.59 (3.13%); 359 guests (Tock) / ~$64.20 check avg. AM: funky crowd, lots of Phish fans and a few large groups. PM: lots going on in Denver but nice flow; roughly 50 guests shy of a typical Saturday, early cuts as needed, great teamwork. Garden: no report left. Kitchen: slow for Rand/Ayu/Fiellah; Rachel & Lucas killed the event. Event: small wedding ceremony/reception for Jesse & Mercedes, 40 guests 6–9pm in Vauxhall — apps and spread from Lucas W & Rachael; B&G thanked the team. Break make-up complete; no-shows charged; no incidents. Favorite moment: post-concert party crowd, no one over-served; later last call for late-night VIP hotel guests. Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 9/5.** Missed target: net $6,812 vs $8,067 target (−16%); food $266, beverage $6,426, retail $120; comps $153 (2%); 215 guests (SevenRooms) / $36 check avg. MOD Kyler. Solid start — room mostly full by 6:30pm, full by 7:30 and stayed full most of the night. Largest hindrance was not having the kitchen at full capacity; guests understanding and excited about popcorn. Few investors/members but high vibes. Door: lively holiday-weekend Saturday, hit capacity in the first hour; birthday and an optometry-exam celebration; a guest with all three books cried tears of joy. No-show: 3 at 7pm (not charged). Menu count 18/18; no breakage; no incidents. Maintenance: leak forming by the downstairs bathroom. Entered by Kyler.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 9/5.** Beat target: net $15,096 vs $12,498 target (+21%); food $2,506; Standing Room $3,636 (food $360), Marquee $10,073 (food $2,145); event sales $1,387; comps $284.21 (Enoch, Sam Leal of VOGUE, member Carlos Martinez, investors, DNLs, gifts); 361 guests / $94.11 check avg. MOD Gigi/Joe; chefs Oscar/Saleh/Josh. Wild night — Joe ran a 4:30pm cocktail class that transferred to the Marquee for dinner; every large table filled from the start; big walk-in and reservation rush ~7pm; turn-and-burn all night with 150+ reservations to start and many large groups on the waitlist. SR crew stayed an extra hour to clear more of the waitlist; Natalie and Gracy creative with seating. Full room at last call. Event: Karen's group loved the class and dinner, will be back. Kitchen: fantastic. Maintenance: freezers behind Marquee have metal parts sticking out — safety hazard. No-shows charged; no incidents. Favorite moment: convincing two parties to stay at the host stand. Entered by Gigi.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Saturday 9/5.** Beat target: net $9,590.67 incl. events vs $9,445 target (+2%). Marquee bar $8,073.67, Garden $1,517, food $1,170, total sales $12,543.33; no events; comps $93.52 (0.9% — investor discounts, gifts), voids $113 (1.2% — DNLs, entry errors); 231 guests (66 resy / 165 walk-in) / $38.67 GA ($82.29 GCA). MOD Josh/Jesse. Steady holiday-weekend night with an even flow of walk-ins and reservations; never really popped off but a few late large parties and the Sophia fan club kept the bar top rocking until last call at 1:30am. Garden steady despite humidity with a late HYROX pop; Jada flew solo. Need better communication around celebration bubbles. Kitchen: smooth night for James; suggest leaving the oven on after kitchen close since cookies are on the snack menu. Went well: water service, marking, packing the space. Do better: running drinks, communication. Maintenance: loose patio panel in the garden, CO2 tank acting up, ice machine leaking. No-shows charged; no incidents. Entered by Jesse.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 9/5.** Beat target: net $16,352 vs $12,289 target (+33%); Municipal Bar AM $3,714 / PM $10,005, Sun Club $766, Hot Eye $1,839; food $5,818; comps $370; 425 guests (OpenTable 138 AM + 287 PM) / ~$38.48 check avg. AM MOD Braden & Lex; PM MOD Justin & Marcus. Morning: busy Saturday, full swing almost all morning with lots of first-time visitors; lunch briefly hectic but controlled. Evening: smooth, evenly paced dinner; strong walk-in happy hour, reservation-heavy 6pm, no waitlist; big rush at the door at 9pm took the floor from half-sat to near max. Sun Club: sunny and hot, hotel-guest business; Lex sold 6 hot dogs and a burger. Hot Eye: slower — steady start, picked up after 10pm, groups camping, small industry pop then cleared by 12:30; a couple of hostile guests but nothing escalated. Kitchen: steady, a few large parties, no lows or 86s. No incidents. Favorite moment: mother/daughter from Atlanta for mom's birthday want Chef Shannon on a cooking show. Entered by Alexis.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Saturday 9/5.** Beat target: net $12,117 vs $10,000 target (+21%); food $1,424; comps $736 (6% — plenty of VIPs but a lot of DNLs and recoveries); 293 guests / $41.35 check avg. MOD Curtis Hayes. 76 covers on the books turned into nearly 300; bar team rocked steady all night and ran breaks for everyone, with solid assists from Belle and Frank. Door and floor were the tougher climb — guests challenging on wait times and seating, but the crew won some turnarounds and worked well together. Kitchen was a one-man show — Josh did ~$1,450 in food solo; hoping to solve kitchen coverage this week. Next week looks bonkers with reservations open to the public. Kitchen note: cannot run full service tomorrow — snacks only; Josh needs time off, no coverage, hire coming. 86: all tartines and desserts, Negroni Verde (temp), Leopold Maryland Rye, Brooklyn; Mexican Firing Squad very low. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: seeing Reagan and meeting her family. Entered by Curtis Hayes.
